The provided text discusses the Big Bang theory, explaining that the universe originated from a tiny singularity approximately 13.8 billion years ago and has been expanding ever since. It cites evidence for this theory, such as the cosmic microwave background radiation and the redshift of distant galaxies, which show that the universe continues to expand outward from its initial starting point.

Regarding your question about the number of days in a typical year: a typical (non-leap) year has 365 days.
